command: require "yaml"; d=YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/agent-history.yml"); j=d.fetch("jobs").fetch("history"); abort "postgres version" unless j.fetch("services").fetch("postgres").fetch("image")=="postgres:18.6-bookworm"; abort "stack" unless j.fetch("env").fetch("RUST_MIN_STACK")=="2097152"; steps=j.fetch("steps").filter_map { |s| s["run"] }.join("\n"); ["agent_history_e2e_", "agent-history-browser.mjs", "history_ci_query_probe", "pg_stat_statements.track_utility"].each { |s| abort s unless steps.include?(s) }; puts "PASS parsed workflow: native journey, actual markup/browser, query-id/settings and stock stack"
